newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish LOT and American Airlines up no. of flights.
newsitem.headline: Polish LOT and American Airlines up no. of flights.

text.p: Polish air carrier PLL LOT SA and AMR Corp's American Airlines will on July 9 increase their number of weekly summer joint flights between Warsaw and the United States to 26 from 14, LOT's spokeswoman said.
"We are introducing new flights from July 9....Five added routes between Warsaw and Chicago will last until the end of the summer," Anna Popek told Reuters on Monday.
New routes will link Warsaw and Miami via Chicago and Warsaw and Los Angeles via New York, Popek said.
According to the code-share agreement between the two airlines, passengers buying tickets can book seats for two stretches of their flight.
Popek said LOT and American Airlines planned to add routes to seven more American cities including Boston, Denver, Washington and Phoenix though these routes had yet to be made official.
